behaviors.preconditions: Remote addition and title edit separated by two seconds; the public installation directory is then temporarily moved away.
behaviors.expected: Available timestamps are bounded by wall-clock seconds and the edit advances the timestamp; unavailable location yields G_MAXUINT64.

behaviors.description: Observe installation monitor notifications for direct lifecycle changes.
behaviors.preconditions: New public monitor connected before each install, update and uninstall; runtime satisfied and remote selected before monitoring.
behaviors.expected: Each operation produces a changed notification while main context is serviced and the expected deployment outcome.

mappings.rationale: Available timestamps must lie in Unix-second wall-clock bounds and advance after a remote change beyond timestamp resolution; temporarily moving the entire public installation directory away must yield G_MAXUINT64.
Independent monitor registration immediately before each direct lifecycle operation, with context-driven event delivery and exact deployment checks.
